tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on canvas (13.2:1) and paper (12.4:1); also the dark surface for inked panels, with canvas text on it (13.2:1). Grain stronger on it.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Soft blue-cream base surface for every screen. Carries the subtle grain.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Nested surfaces: cards, chips' ground, calendar cells. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Warm blue, the identity: hero actions, selected days, stamps, links. Canvas text on a blue fill is 4.5:1; blue as text on canvas is 4.5:1 (AA, exactly). FLAG: blue text on paper is 4.2:1 — fails AA for body text; use it there only at 24px+ or for icons.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Hover on dark surfaces, secondary fills, calendar event backgrounds (ink text on it, 5.6:1). Never text on canvas (2.4:1).

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Inked surfaces: headers, the active care plan panel. Canvas text on it is 8.1:1. Grain stronger on it.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status only: confirmed, covered. FLAG: as text on canvas 4.45:1, just under AA 4.5:1 (on paper 4.2:1); pair with its stamp/glyph and keep text in ink, or adjust.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Status only: needs attention, missing info. FLAG: fails AA as text on canvas (3.0:1) and paper (2.8:1). Use as a fill with ink text on it (4.4:1, still under 4.5) or as a glyph at 3:1+ on canvas; text stays ink.

tokens.name: urgent
tokens.usage: Status only: overdue medication, missed appointment. Text on canvas 4.8:1; canvas text on an urgent fill 4.8:1.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Good morning, Rosa. You're all set.
styles.usage: Emotion only: greetings, the patient's name, milestones, "you're all set". Never below 22pt (≈29.3px) — 30px is that floor, not a full scale.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body, labels and every numeral, with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. 16px is the product-wide minimum.
